description: Liège - micromobilité, zones de déploiement et de restriction is a group of related datasets listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Liège. Le jeu de données permet d’identifier la zone d’opération définie par le règlement fixant les conditions d'exploitation des véhicules de cyclopartage en flotte libre de la Ville de Liège. À cette zone d'opération est associé un quota de véhicules de type trottinettes qu'un opérateur est autorisé à. Coverage: Liège. The portal lists 2 related datasets of one publisher (copies, years or sister lists), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are trottinette, mobilité douce, mobilité. The portal shows 1 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-03-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
